$schema: IFS Prioritization Engine - Manual Mode Schema
description: Structured manifest of input fields and scoring variables for the MANUAL version of the IFS Framework (excludes Demo Mode, MCP integration, and Jira sync features)

step1_setContext.description: Organizational context fields that frame all prioritization decisions

contextTitle.label: Context Title
contextTitle.description: A short, descriptive name for this prioritization context

clientContext.label: Client Context
clientContext.placeholder: Describe the client organization: industry, size, current systems, strategic goals, key stakeholders, and any critical constraints or deadlines...
clientContext.description: Holistic description of the organization's industry, size, current state, and strategic objectives that frames all prioritization decisions
clientContext.tooltipExample: Fortune 500 insurance company modernizing claims processing. Legacy mainframe systems, 10,000+ agents, Q4 deadline for digital transformation.

organizationalFocus.label: Strategic Focus
organizationalFocus.description: Primary strategic objective guiding prioritization. Affects Impact scoring through strategic alignment bonus.

resourceCapacity.label: Resource Capacity
resourceCapacity.description: Available resources for AI initiative delivery. Contextualizes Feasibility assessment.

step2_defineInitiative.description: Initiative-specific fields for the AI use case being evaluated

initiativeTitle.label: Initiative Title
initiativeTitle.description: Concise name for the AI initiative. Used to identify the initiative in portfolio views and analysis results.
initiativeTitle.tooltipExample: Regional Variant Engine or Smart Email Composer

useCaseDescription.label: AI Initiative Description
useCaseDescription.placeholder: Describe the AI-powered capability, what it automates, and the expected outcome...
useCaseDescription.description: Detailed description of the AI use case, what it automates, and intended outcomes
useCaseDescription.affectsScoring: Used for contextAffinity calculation and strategic alignment detection

prioritizationContext.label: Prioritization Context
prioritizationContext.placeholder: Additional context for prioritization (dependencies, constraints, stakeholder requirements)...
prioritizationContext.description: Supplementary context specific to this initiative's prioritization. Optional field for additional detail.

workType.label: Work Type

options.label: Activation
options.description: Direct value delivery - customer-facing or revenue-generating AI capability

options.label: Enablement
options.description: Foundational infrastructure - APIs, data pipelines, platforms that unlock other initiatives

workType.description: Classification of initiative type. Enablement type triggers +2 Impact bonus if it unlocks 2+ Activation use cases.

makes10xFaster.label: 10x Bottleneck Test
makes10xFaster.description: Check if this initiative eliminates a workflow bottleneck by 10x or more
makes10xFaster.affectsScoring: Displayed as badge in synthesis; influences archetype reasoning

contextAffinityMeter.description: Visual indicator showing alignment between initiative description and organizational context
contextAffinityMeter.calculation: Keyword matching between useCaseDescription and (clientContext + organizationalFocus)

step3_scoring.description: IFS scoring sliders and final classification

impact.label: Impact
impact.description: Business value and strategic importance of the initiative

1-3.label: Low Impact
1-3.description: No visible impact on strategic goals or customer experience

4-6.label: Moderate Impact
4-6.description: Partial improvement; incremental value but not transformative

7-10.label: High Impact
7-10.description: Direct value creation; eliminates a top-3 constraint or 10x improvement

feasibility.label: Feasibility
feasibility.description: Technical and organizational ability to deliver

7-10.label: Clear Path
7-10.description: Clear path; dependencies resolved or minimal

penalties.name: feasibilityPenalty
penalties.condition: Required enabler is Stalled or Missing

scalability.label: Scalability
scalability.description: Ability to scale autonomously without human bottlenecks

foundationsManagement.description: Linked enablement dependencies. Adding a foundation to an Activation initiative triggers enablementBonus for that foundation.

scoringEngine.description: All variables and formulas used in the IFS scoring calculation

enablementBonus.description: +2 Impact bonus for Enablement initiatives that unlock 2 or more Activation use cases

hasStrategicBonus.description: +1 Impact bonus if initiative description contains keywords aligned with strategic focus

feasibilityPenalty.description: -2 Feasibility penalty when a required enabler dependency is Stalled or Missing

adjustedImpact.description: Final Impact score after applying bonuses, capped at 10

adjustedFeasibility.description: Final Feasibility score after applying blocker penalty, minimum 1

totalScore.description: Final IFS composite score using multiplicative formula (not additive)
totalScore.note: Multiplicative scoring means all three dimensions must be strong for high scores

contextAffinity.formula: keyword matching algorithm comparing useCaseDescription against (clientContext + organizationalFocus)
contextAffinity.description: Percentage (0-100) indicating alignment between initiative and organizational context

certaintyScore.formula: weighted average of data completeness factors
certaintyScore.description: Confidence level (0-100%) in the archetype classification
factors: Override confidence (reduced if scores were manually overridden)

overrideTracking.description: Audit log of all manual score adjustments with justifications

archetypeClassification.description: Strategic archetype classification based on IFS scores. Evaluated in priority order - first match wins.

archetypes.name: Transformer
archetypes.description: High impact, feasibility, and scalability. Ship immediately.

archetypes.name: The Foundation

condition.pseudocode: High strategic value but blocked; requires infrastructure investment

archetypes.description: Critical enablement work. Invest in infrastructure first.

archetypes.name: Quick Win

condition.pseudocode: Easy to deliver with moderate business value

archetypes.description: High feasibility with moderate impact. Build momentum.

archetypes.name: The Experiment
archetypes.description: Moderate potential. Time-box exploration to validate.

archetypes.name: Money Pit

condition.pseudocode: Easy to build but cannot scale autonomously

archetypes.description: Easy to build but won't scale. Defer or redesign.

archetypes.name: The Noise
archetypes.description: Low value across all dimensions. Discard.

condition.rule: default fallback - no other condition matched
condition.pseudocode: Scores don't fit any established pattern

evaluationOrder: 1. Transformer (totalScore > 100) - checked first as highest priority
2. The Foundation (enablement with high I/S, low F)
5. Money Pit (low S, high F - scaling problem)

stateManagement.description: All React state variables used in Manual Mode

dataMode.description: Data input mode - 'manual' for this manifest

isContextSet.description: Whether Step 1 context has been confirmed

contextTitle.description: User-defined name for the prioritization context
